title: He Fooled the Entire Crowd… 😳🃏
description:
A magician steps onto the Britain’s Got Talent stage and pulls off a card trick that leaves Simon Cowell doing a double take. The crowd reacts, Sofia can’t hold back her shock — but as the moment unfolds, even the judges start asking the same question: was any of this real? Watch till the end.
